description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for acknowledgements in the Eclipse Ditto project, including timeout durations, payload size limits, and associated configuration values.

classes.name: AcknowledgementConfig
classes.description: Interface providing methods to retrieve acknowledgement configuration parameters.

classes.name: AcknowledgementConfig.AcknowledgementConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining known configuration path expressions and default values for acknowledgement settings.

methods.name: getForwarderFallbackTimeout
methods.description: Returns the fallback timeout for correlating acknowledgements.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackLifetime
methods.description: Returns the fallback lifetime for collecting acknowledgements.

methods.name: getCollectorFallbackAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the fallback timeout when asking for acknowledgement output.

methods.name: getIssuedMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum payload size in bytes for automatically issued acknowledgements.
